searchAPI: direct EmojiSuggester.search raw query; unchanged wrapper archived, not linked or called
percentile: sort ascending; p95 = sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]; no interpolation
median: all12 sorted construction/memory values; arithmetic mean of positions5 and6 (zero based)
queryAggregation: pooled all12*7374 measured query latencies per variant; additionally require max per-process p95 <= max(2*maxBaselineProcessP95, maxBaselineProcessP95+0.25) AND <=2ms
queryMaximum: maximum of every query across all12 measured candidate processes <=10ms; all warmup extrema also reported but warmups never pooled into measured gates
retainedGate: both median of12 signed paired absolute post-construction RSS(candidate-baseline) AND median of12 signed paired build deltas((postConstruction-postDecode)candidate - matchingBaseline) <=2097152 bytes
peakGate: both maximum of12 signed paired absolute construction-stage ru_maxrss(candidate-baseline) AND maximum paired construction-stage peak-minus-postDecodeRSS difference <=4194304 bytes
memoryStage: construction-stage peak sampled before query result serialization; post-query RSS/peak reported separately and cannot replace construction-stage data
ratios: candidate/baseline for positive baseline; null otherwise; signed bytes remain unclamped

quiet.authorization: fresh delegated measurement task only; parent START with explicit grant ID, timestamp, expiry and this freeze SHA256
quiet.evidence: Mach host CPU ticks, load averages and ps pid/ppid/pcpu/comm executable basename only before, during (~0.5s), after; no command arguments
quiet.interpretation: any sample summed %CPU of external processes >25 (one-core units), unavailable CPU/process evidence, a gap >5s, grant expiry or missing parent assertion of exclusive uninterrupted quiet batch => UNAVAILABLE; all raw samples retained; no causal excuses, subsets or restarts
quiet.excluded: driver PID and its live descendants (serial probe, evidence ps); all excluded processes remain in evidence
quiet.observer: single driver monitor thread; sampling overhead disclosed; CPU thresholds are operational quiet-evidence rejection, never changed after data

estimation: unmeasured planning allowance 10-20 minutes including evidence and archive; no empirical duration claim; parent grant recommended >=30min to avoid expiry
native: UNRUN; separate actual iOS cold index and first-search later; no macOS latency inference
